evidence.text: SPICY ORGANIC Coriander Seeds - Pure USDA Organic - Non-GMO Coriander Seeds Whole - 16 Oz

100% ORGANIC: Organic coriander seeds, certified organic by the Texas Department of Agriculture. Coriander is a very aromatic spice with a sweet, mild, and nutty flavor, which is best known as the major component of ground coriander. The spice is made from the dried fruit (called coriander seeds) of the plant Coriander sativum.

RECIPES & SPICE BLENDS: Our organic coriander seeds are a staple for many cuisines, used in everything from spicy curries to Mediterranean dishes. They are available whole or ground, and when used whole, they add a fragrant, earthy aroma and taste to food.

ADD CORIANDER FLAVOR: Organic coriander seeds. Add to chili, stew and curry dishes. Use it in place of dried coriander to flavor rice, soups, and stews. Sprinkle it on salads and cream cheese. In warmer climates, they can be grown as potherbs, like parsley or fennel.

AROMATIC AND FLAVORFUL: The organic coriander plant is well known for its distinctive citrus aroma and taste that provide a unique character to any food dish. Perfect for garnishing curries, ground meat dishes, and salads. The seeds spice up both your beverages and food, while the herb itself is known to keep insects away from the treated area.

USES: Organic coriander seeds are the dried fruit of a parsley-like herb. Its leaves, part of the carrot family, are used for flavoring in cooking. The seed is most commonly and extensively used in combination with other spices to flavor foods in South Asian and Middle Eastern cuisines.

Coriander seeds are a classic ingredient in the kitchen. Whether you are making curry, pickling or simply adding to a recipe, these coriander seeds deliver a distinctive flavor that is all their own. These whole coriander seeds are both pungent and flavorful. They have a strong, warm fragrance with citrus undertones. These whole seeds can be crushed using a mortar and pestle, or any other grinding device. Also referred to as cilantro seeds, their flavor can be used in various different types of cuisines around the world. Whether you want to add a dash or two of it to your curry, or want to marinade fish in this unique and highly fragrant spice blend, having fresh coriander seeds and using them fresh is a must!
